annotations.title: Draw the section through a drillhole

description: The vertical section a geologist draws through a drillhole: along the hole's own azimuth (east-west for a vertical hole or one whose direction was not recorded), as long as the drilling near the line reaches. Returns the line (ends, azimuth, bearing, which way it looks, length, the projected CRS), the 1:500k bedrock units it crosses with their distances along it, the faults it crosses with their apparent dip in the section, the local strike, and the holes within width_m of the line: their distance along it and off it, collar RL, depth and best intercepts for the element. Give the hole's collar (lon/lat, e.g. from find_drillholes) and, when several holes stand close together, its name.

hole.description: The hole's name; else the hole nearest lon/lat.

width_m.description: Holes this far either side of the line are on the section.
